title: 重力の深淵における帰還運動
author: 七海 シグマ

prediction.question: 構造体の中でレイを待ち受けるカインの真の目的とは？
options: カインもまた先駆者に囚われている
異次元への扉を自ら開こうとする
時空を巻き戻し歴史の改変を狙う

en.title: Return Trajectory in the Abyss of Gravity
en.premise: Amidst a spacetime navigation experiment utilizing the extreme gravitational gradient of a neutron star, Ray, a crew member of the observation ship, discovers a mysterious structure seemingly suspended just before the event horizon. Within it are inscribed a "secret map" left behind by pioneers who should have perished centuries ago due to the decay of the speed of light, and coordinates to a different dimension known as the "Promised Hill," warped by the tidal forces of the star. Challenging the limits of physical laws, humanity witnesses the true form of the universe at the edge of gravitational collapse.

zh.title: 重力深渊中的归还轨迹
zh.premise: 在利用中子星极端的引力梯度进行的时空航行实验中，观测船船员雷在事件视界边缘发现了一个仿佛静止般的神秘结构。那里记录着因光速衰减而在数百年前便应已逝去的先驱者们留下的“秘密地图”，以及因恒星潮汐力而扭曲、通往名为“约定之丘”的异次元坐标。挑战物理法则极限的人类，将在引力坍缩的边缘目睹宇宙的真实面貌。
